text:
Rosa (CS): Heads-up  HarborData is asking for a short LATAM region QPS increase + edge allowlist for a partner integration test next Wed. Renewal call scheduled next week; they said demo outcome could change the deal.
Diego (SE): Which region/endpoints/models and source IPs? Also asked about VPC peering possibility? Need org id.
Rosa (CS): Customer details: region sa-east-1 (So Paulo). Endpoints: /v1/chat (gpt-redwood-8k-chat), /v1/embeddings. Current org QPS=40, requested burst=220 QPS for 3 hours. CIDRs: 201.6.0.0/20, 186.192.64.0/18. Org: harbordata-prod. They also asked if a temporary private peering could be evaluated but said allowlist is primary ask.
Mei (NetOps): We can add those CIDRs to the LATAM edge allowlist and create a timebound policy with auto-revoke. VPC peering is heavier; need procurement + infra review. For now we should scope allowlist + throttle fallback. ETA ~30m after ticket approval.
Tara (Support): Opening ticket for audit trail and to collect signed addendum: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/90221. Please upload signed doc there; I'll add rollback steps.
Diego (SE): Recommend model overrides to limit compute tail: set /v1/chat -> gpt-redwood-8k-chat:reduced-batch and enable prefix KV caching for sessions. Also add a small eval probe to guard quality. Proposed patch to ops (JSON snippet):
```
{
  "org": "harbordata-prod",
  "region": "sa-east-1",
  "qps": "220",
  "window": "2025-02-12T14:00:00-03:00/2025-02-12T17:00:00-03:00",
  "allowlist": ["201.6.0.0/20", "186.192.64.0/18"],
  "model_overrides": {"/v1/chat": "gpt-redwood-8k-chat:reduced-batch"},
  "auto_revoke": "true"
}
```
Mei (NetOps): Looks good. We'll apply a safety fallback at 100 QPS if backend pressure rises. I'll queue the change once support confirms the addendum.
ops-bot: Change request queued: #CR-15733  temp-latam-qps-harbordata-prod assigned to @Mei.
Mei (NetOps): Applied: LATAM edge allowlist updated with provided CIDRs, routing policy set, temp QPS=220 live, fallback=100 QPS, auto-revoke scheduled for 2025-02-12T17:05:00-03:00. Canary calls returned 200.
Tara (Support): Signed addendum and rollback checklist uploaded to ticket 90221. Added note: "temporary QPS exception granted; auto-revoke scheduled; billing notified."
Kyle (Billing): Quick cost estimate for finance ops: ~USD 420 incremental for the 3h burst (GPU + egress), pending final metric calc. I'll attach the estimate to the ticket.
Diego (SE): I'll monitor latency and error rates during the window and run the eval probe to detect any quality deviations from reduced-batch. Will escalate if errors >2% or p95 jumps >200ms.
Rosa (CS): Thanks team  I'll flag renewal lead and attach ticket + addendum. Customer plans a dress rehearsal tomorrow. Please post a brief summary in the ticket after the window.
ops-bot: Change request #CR-15733 status=applied auto-revoke=scheduled.
Rosa (CS): Follow-up: rehearsal successful, live test completed, customer said performance was acceptable and it strengthened renewal conversation. Kyle, please add final cost and note to ticket for renewal ops. :tada:
